args.subject: Resume Template - Update
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I found the resume template website you mentioned (www.resume-templates.com). The download links are hosted on resume-templates-portal.com, but I'm currently unable to download the files directly due to system policy restrictions.

The download pages I found are:
- https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links (for resume_template.pdf)
- https://www.resume-templates-portal.com/download_links/resume_template_part2.pdf (for the second part)

Would you like me to try alternative methods, or do you have another way you'd prefer to receive the template? Alternatively, you could visit the website directly and download it yourself.

Best regards,
Emma
